speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you've had fatigue, flank pain, and fever after recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. Have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, urgency, or cloudy/bloody urine?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: That combination of findings—specifically the presence of binucleated eosinophils in the urine alongside negative bacterial cultures—strongly suggests an allergic interstitial process. Have you noticed a new rash, hives, or itchy skin since starting those antibiotics? REQUEST TEST: Serum_IgE; REQUEST TEST: Renal_Function_Panel.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic hypersensitivity. The presence of eosinophilic granular casts, elevated IgE, and rising creatinine following antibiotic treatment confirms this diagnosis.
